items.title: Mbalula blames ANC infighting for party’s defeat in Nelson Mandela Bay as DA emerges victorious
items.summary: ANC secretary-general Fikile Mbalula has blamed internal party divisions for the ANC’s loss of Nelson Mandela Bay, where DA councillor Retief Odendaal was elected mayor at the head of a six-party coalition.

items.title: DA condemns ANC-ActionSA deal after giving eThekwini leadership to MK Party
items.summary: The DA accused the ANC and ActionSA of choosing political instability over service delivery after the MK Party secured eThekwini’s mayoralty and deputy mayoralty, while the ANC took the speaker and chief whip positions.

items.title: Herman Mashaba returns as Johannesburg Mayor after defeating Helen Zille
items.summary: ActionSA leader Herman Mashaba has been elected Johannesburg mayor after securing 170 votes against DA candidate Helen Zille’s 97.

items.title: DA vows to hold new eThekwini administration accountable after ANC, ActionSA back MK Party
items.summary: The DA said it will mount a strong opposition in eThekwini after the MK Party secured the mayoralty with support from the ANC and ActionSA, excluding the DA from the city’s governing administration.

items.title: Decide reparations now or Europe will decide for you, Africa warned
items.summary: The message from Amsterdam was clear: the era of debating whether reparations are owed is over. The era of deciding how they will be paid and who decides has begun.

items.title: Security firms face R1m fine for deploying unregistered foreign nationals, says PSiRA
items.summary: PSiRA has warned security companies to verify officers’ registration and work eligibility, saying non-compliant firms could face penalties of up to R1 million.

items.title: MK Party’s Thabani Luthuli elected eThekwini deputy mayor
items.summary: MKP councillor Thabani Luthuli defeated IFP candidate Sizwe Sikhakhane by 137 votes to 78 at eThekwini’s inaugural council meeting on Friday.

items.title: ConCourt dismisses challenges to NHI Bill in major victory for Ramaphosa’s healthcare reform
items.summary: The Constitutional Court has dismissed two challenges to Parliament’s public participation process during the passage of the National Health Insurance Act.

items.title: ANC’s Mziyanda Mketsu elected new Ekurhuleni mayor
items.summary: The ANC has secured the Ekurhuleni mayoral position, with councillor Mziyanda Mketsu elected as the new mayor after defeating Democratic Alliance (DA) candidate Khathutshelo Rasilingwane in Friday’s council sitting.

items.title: LOCAL ELECTIONS 2026: ANC deal gets MK mayor elected in eThekwini, realigning KZN politics
items.summary: The DA’s last-ditch attempt to form a coalition with the ANC in eThekwini failed, leading to the MK party taking its first metro and setting its sights on leading the province.

items.title: PARTY POLITICS: Mbaks lashes out at Mbeki — ‘You can’t attack the ANC in public’
items.summary: Fikile Mbalula has criticised former president Thabo Mbeki for publicly calling on ANC leaders to take responsibility for the party’s electoral decline.

items.title: NARROW RULING: ConCourt dismisses NHI challenges, but battle over universal healthcare plan continues
items.summary: The Constitutional Court dismissed two cases that dealt primarily with the process of Parliament assenting to the National Health Insurance Act, but justices were split five to six in one of the rulings.

items.title: OCEANS GOVERNANCE: SA risks being benched as world decides who controls the high seas
items.summary: The experienced maritime state will in all likelihood miss the diplomatic opportunity to secure voting rights at the opening of the world’s first High Seas Treaty conference in New York in January.

items.title: OBITUARY: Lutz van Dijk, a fighter for orphans and voice for queer Nazi victims
items.summary: The Berlin-born campaigner founded a children’s home in a Cape Town township, helped rebuild it after a fire and wrote more than 50 books.
